question_text: Passage: 'RA 6713 requires all public officials to file a Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN). This ensures transparency and accountability in government service.' What is the purpose of the SALN?

hint_ladder.title: Hanapin ang Purpose sa Passage
hint_ladder.text: Sabi sa passage: ‘This ensures transparency and accountability.’ Ang ‘This’ ay tumutukoy sa SALN. Kaya ‘yan mismo ang purpose.

hint_ladder.title: Kilalanin ang Key Phrase
hint_ladder.text: Ang pariralang ‘ensures transparency and accountability’ ang direktang sagot sa tanong. Huwag nang lumayo.

hint_ladder.title: Tanggalin ang Hindi Nabanggit
hint_ladder.text: Ang pagtaas ng tax, job performance, o promotions ay wala sa passage. Huwag mag-imbento.

hint_ladder.title: Confirm the Right Answer
hint_ladder.text: Tama! ‘To ensure transparency and accountability.’ Ulit-ulitin: SALN = transparency at accountability, hindi tax o promotion.

A.text: You might have chosen A because you thought financial disclosure leads to higher taxes, but the passage doesn’t mention taxes.

B.text: Correct. The passage explicitly states that SALN ensures transparency and accountability.

C.text: You might have chosen C because you linked SALN to evaluating work, but performance evaluation is not mentioned.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you assumed SALN helps with promotions, but the passage only speaks of transparency.

next_time_rule: Kapag may passage, kunin ang direktang sagot. SALN = ‘ensures transparency and accountability,’ hindi tax, performance, o promotions. Quote from the text!
